text: Engage (संलग्न गराउनु), 5 min: greet students and ask 'What did you see on your way to school today?'. Write responses (paddy field, goat, river, tree, bird, sun, mountain, road, house) on the board without labeling, then ask whether all the things are the same or different to spark curiosity.
source: Exemplar: Components of Environment (reference lesson lp1)
subject: Science

text: Explore (अन्वेषण गर्नु), 10 min: divide students into small groups and give component cards (sunlight, air, water, soil, rice plant, goat, mushroom, bacteria, stone, butterfly). Ask them to sort the cards into two groups by their own understanding while the teacher circulates asking guiding questions.
source: Exemplar: Components of Environment (reference lesson lp1)
subject: Science

text: Explain (व्याख्या गर्नु), 15 min: invite groups to present, correct misconceptions (clouds move but are not living), then explain biotic and abiotic components and introduce producers (rice plant), consumers (goat), and decomposers (mushroom, bacteria) while drawing a concept map.
source: Exemplar: Components of Environment (reference lesson lp1)
subject: Science

text: Expand (विस्तार गर्नु), 10 min: give the scene 'A rice field contains soil, sunlight, water, rice plants, goats, and mushrooms — classify each' and have students explain why each item is biotic or abiotic and identify producers, consumers, and decomposers.
source: Exemplar: Components of Environment (reference lesson lp1)
subject: Science

text: Evaluate (मूल्याङ्कन गर्नु), 5 min: ask oral questions — What is the environment? Name one biotic and one abiotic component. Which is a producer, consumer, decomposer? Is soil biotic or abiotic and why? — observing participation as the assessment.
source: Exemplar: Components of Environment (reference lesson lp1)
subject: Science

text: Homework (Environment): draw any four things found around your home, write B (Biotic) or A (Abiotic) below each, and for biotic items note whether it is a Producer, Consumer, or Decomposer.
source: Exemplar: Components of Environment (reference lesson lp1)
subject: Science
